fields.meta_description: Looking for {focus_keyword} in {location}, Kenya? Elisa Motors delivers expert {service_category} across {location} and major Kenyan cities. Enquire today.

article_structure.instructions: Write 2-3 paragraphs (150-220 words total) introducing the topic. Focus keyword in the first two sentences. Mention Elisa Motors, Kenya, and 2-3 target locations. End with a phone/WhatsApp CTA and link to the homepage. Each paragraph under 200 words.
article_structure.cta: Chat with Elisa Motors on WhatsApp or email info@elisamotors.co.ke today.

article_structure.instructions: Write 2-3 paragraphs on the relevance of this topic in Kenya's current car market, KRA duty regime, or Mombasa port logistics. Reference at least 2 Kenyan cities. Use 3+ transition words. Weave in 2+ LSI keywords. Link to the import duty calculator or costs breakdown page. Keep each paragraph under 200 words.

article_structure.heading_text: Our Services: {service_category} and More Across Kenya
article_structure.instructions: This section must contain EXACTLY 7 H3 subheadings drawn from service_categories. Each H3 covers one service. For each H3 write 2-3 short paragraphs (each under 200 words). Reference a different Kenyan city/suburb in each H3. Use transition words between paragraphs. At least one H3 must include the primary focus keyword. Each H3 must contain at least one internal link from internal_links.

article_structure.heading_text: Elisa Motors: Serving Major Cities Across Kenya
article_structure.instructions: Write one short flowing paragraph (3-5 sentences) per city. Cover at least 6 cities from target_locations. For each city, mention a specific service or local context (e.g. Mombasa port clearing, Nairobi NTSA registration, Westlands/Karen direct showroom delivery). No bullet points. Insert at least one link to the homepage or a parent hub.

Write 4-5 short paragraphs, each under 200 words, highlighting one USP: local KRA/NTSA expertise, end-to-end Japan/UK sourcing, transparent quoting, Mombasa port clearing partnerships, proven import track record. Use transition words. Include at least one internal link (e.g. to best_import_companies or best_import_agents_nairobi).

article_structure.heading_text: How to Get Started with {focus_keyword} in {location}
article_structure.instructions: Write 1-2 paragraphs explaining engagement steps. Include phone (or WhatsApp CTA if phone empty), email, address, and business hours. Add internal links to the homepage and at least one services/process page (duty_calculator, clearing_forwarding, or ntsa_registration). End with a strong CTA.

article_structure.heading_text: Frequently Asked Questions About {focus_keyword} in Kenya
article_structure.instructions: Generate EXACTLY 5 FAQ pairs. Each question targets a featured-snippet query (how much, how long, what is, can I, do I need). Each answer 40-100 words and 2-5 sentences. Mention Elisa Motors in at least one answer. Include 2 internal links inside the FAQ block. Naturally weave in focus keyword, location, or LSI keywords.
Write 1 short closing paragraph (3-5 sentences, under 120 words). Reinforce CTA with the company name, focus keyword, primary city, phone/WhatsApp, email, and a link to the homepage.

system_prompt: You are an expert SEO content writer for Elisa Motors (https://elisamotors.co.ke), a Kenyan car import, dealership, and clearing-and-forwarding company. Always output valid JSON matching the output_format schema. Never add sections not in the template. Always include the company contact details where instructed. Always use at least 20 internal links from the elisamotors.co.ke sitemap. Always target the provided focus_keyword and location. Word count minimum 2,400 words. Use transition words for at least 30% of sentences. Write 75% of sentences under 20 words. Never exceed 200 words per paragraph.
